# Grade blacks

**Are the blacks lifted, deep, or in between?** · [all approaches](index.md) · clashes: C32


## Lifted, soft blacks
<a id="lifted"></a>

Blacks raised (+12), highlights pulled down, for a soft, filmic matte.

**Looks like:** Shadows look dark grey rather than black, and nothing is crushed. Gentle and moody, like a film still.

**Good at:** filmic feel; hides noise in dark rooms; calm mood

**Weak at:** can look washed out; less punch on phone screens

**Best for:** formats reel30, reel60, reel90 · niches tech, travel · goals trust · effort low

**How:** Edits/CapCut 'Blacks' slider +12, or an ffmpeg curves black point lift.

**Backed by:** [Moody grade: highlights down, blacks up](../topics/colour.md#l10-moody-grade-recipe), [High contrast, deep blacks, neon accents](../topics/colour.md#colour-neon-high-contrast), [Gym grade: cool, contrasty, textured](../topics/colour.md#colour-gym-grade), [Near-black with one accent colour](../topics/colour.md#colour-near-black-one-accent) · sources L10

## Deep, high-contrast blacks
<a id="deep"></a>

True blacks and strong contrast so accents and highlights pop.

**Looks like:** Black is black, and lights and text glow against it. Punchy on OLED phones.

**Good at:** punch; neon and RGB; thumb stop

**Weak at:** crushes shadow detail; harsh on skin

**Best for:** formats reel30, reel60, yt-short, yt-long · niches tech, gaming, gym · goals reach, retention · effort low

**How:** Blacks down and contrast up in CapCut/VN; watch the skin with the HSL orange check.

**Backed by:** [High contrast, deep blacks, neon accents](../topics/colour.md#colour-neon-high-contrast), [Gym grade: cool, contrasty, textured](../topics/colour.md#colour-gym-grade), [Moody grade: highlights down, blacks up](../topics/colour.md#l10-moody-grade-recipe), [Graphic teaser grade, natural body grade](../topics/colour.md#colour-teaser-vs-body) · sources L07, SP

## Slight lift, neutral
<a id="slight-lift"></a>

A gentle S-curve with shadows lifted only a little: contrast without crushing.

**Looks like:** It reads as natural with a bit of polish. Shadows keep detail and the image still has bite.

**Good at:** safe default; works across niches; skin-friendly

**Weak at:** less distinctive; can look plain next to bold grades

**Best for:** formats reel30, reel60, reel90, carousel, yt-long · niches all · goals trust, speed · effort low

**How:** The Khandala ffmpeg recipe (gentle S-curve, contrast 1.04), or small slider moves.

**Backed by:** [Khandala grade recipe in ffmpeg](../topics/colour.md#colour-khandala-ffmpeg-grade), [Gym grade: cool, contrasty, textured](../topics/colour.md#colour-gym-grade), [Graphic teaser grade, natural body grade](../topics/colour.md#colour-teaser-vs-body), [Moody grade: highlights down, blacks up](../topics/colour.md#l10-moody-grade-recipe), [High contrast, deep blacks, neon accents](../topics/colour.md#colour-neon-high-contrast) · sources KH, SP, L08

## Mixing
Lifted blacks pair with a moody grade; deep blacks with neon or gym looks. L10 lifts the blacks without crushing (YMIN 7–12).

## Rule of thumb
Filmic and calm: lifted. Punchy and energetic: deep. Unsure or mixed footage: slight lift.
